summary: Temporary drone danger area in Aston, Birmingham, with drone flights limited to 400 feet above ground, daily from 0700 to 2300.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD289A INSTALLED WI 1.65NM RADIUS OF
523022N 0015244W (ASTON, BIRMINGHAM). BEYOND VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT
(BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT 400FT AGL. 
EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL 
DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT 
(VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR 
DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR 
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE 
REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722 5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR 
IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE EFFORT. FOR INFO 
AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. 
DEC 24-JAN 03 CTC 
DFR(UNDERSCORE)TEAM(AT)WESTMIDLANDS.POLICE.UKAR-2026-2313/08.
